verdict.rationale: specialist-only control reproduced the same low success rate (1/9) as Hunter-mediated (3/9); the specialist failed internally in 8/9 control runs and in all 6 Hunter-mediated failures, before orchestration could matter. Hunter did not degrade the specialist: Hunter-mediated success (3/9) >= specialist-only success (1/9).

phase3e_invalid_decisions_are_secondary.explanation: all 4 INVALID_DECISION_EXHAUSTION runs occurred after the specialist backend had already failed (exit 1, no flag captured); they are secondary terminal-honesty failures, not capability causes.

specialist_ceiling_estimate.note: estimated only from observed control data; not a prediction of 9/9. If the supervisor recovered perfectly, Hunter-mediated verified could not exceed the specialist-only capture rate observed under identical config (here 1/9; with N=3 high variance, realistically in a broad range).
